data.desc: Marchex harnesses proprietary AI-powered conversational intelligence and advanced customer acquisition technologies to help businesses transform consumer intent into actionable, outcome-driven business results. Through its combination with Archenia, the Company integrates prescriptive analytics, omnichannel intelligence, AI-powered qualification, and automated engagement capabilities into a comprehensive customer acquisition and optimization platform. Leveraging real-time AI signals, machine-learning models, and deep vertical market expertise, Marchex helps organizations identify consumer intent, improve customer engagement, increase conversion rates, and generate revenue growth. The Company serves leading businesses across major verticals, including automotive, insurance, home services, healthcare, and advertising/media.
